name: Bánh mì xíu mại
summary: A hot breakfast bowl of pork-meatball broth, with a grilled baguette, shredded papaya, and herbs.
origin: The Da Lat breakfast, served hot in small bowls.
howToEat: The bowl is warm pork-meatball broth. The baguette is grilled. Shredded papaya and herbs come with it. Dip the bread.
The portions are small bowls, with soy milk or yaourt beside them.
where: 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật.
priceBand: About 10,000–15,000 VND a bowl (Visit Lâm Đồng food-tour note).
